The '''Salagor system''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that shared its name with the [[43rd Salagori Lancers]], a [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] unit of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="HeroesRogues">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Salagor system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square N-13.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
